title: A Paw Patrol Christmas
overview: Rubble is looking forward to Santa bringing him a new laser drill, but finds that Santa has come down with a cold and can’t deliver any presents. When Mayor Humdinger decides he’s going to the North Pole to take all the gifts for himself, it’s up to the PAW Patrol to stop him.

title: Alien TV
overview: Alien reporters Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee travel to a lovely but odd planet called Earth, where they attempt to make sense of humans and their hobbies.

title: Barney's World
overview: Set in a local playground, Barney is joined by dinos Billy and Baby Bop and their three kid best friends. Throughout silly and imaginative adventures together, Barney helps kids explore big preschool emotions and shows them how to love themselves and others.

title: Carmen Sandiego
overview: A master thief who uses her skills for good, Carmen Sandiego travels the world foiling V.I.L.E.'s evil plans — with help from her savvy sidekicks.

title: Chip and Potato
overview: Lovable pug Chip starts kindergarten, makes new friends and tries new things -- with a little help from Potato, her secret mouse pal.

title: Cupcake & Dino - General Services
overview: An enterprising cupcake and his cheerful dinosaur brother take on jobs of all sorts as they work to help friends and strangers in their eccentric city.

title: Dance & Sing with True
overview: True and her friends are making music -- and they want you to dance and sing along. So cut loose, silly goose! These fun beats are totally sweet.

title: Hello Ninja
overview: BFFs Wesley and Georgie and their silly cat sidekick Pretzel transform into ninjas and enter a magic world, where they solve problems and save the day.

title: Mighty Express
overview: Catch a ride with the Mighty Express — a team of trains and their kid friends who overcome trouble on the tracks with quick thinking and teamwork!

title: ReBoot: The Guardian Code
overview: Four tech-savvy teens hone their skills as cyber-superheroes in a series of secret missions to save the world.

title: StarBeam
overview: Zoey is excited to tackle second grade, but when danger beckons, she sneaks away and with her signature call out and transforms into StarBeam, the speediest, most powerful and most enthusiastic superhero to ever sip from a juicebox.

title: StarBeam: Beaming in the New Year
overview: Summersette's biggest baddies join forces on New Year’s Eve to battle Zoey and the Beam Team. But cool cousin Zara powers up to help save the day!

title: StarBeam: Halloween Hero
overview: Greedy Captain Fishbeard is stealing everybody's Halloween treats for himself, but StarBeam and Boost have some tricks up their sleeves to save the day!

title: Strawberry Shortcake: Berry in the Big City
overview: Aspiring baker Strawberry Shortcake arrives in Big Apple City to get her big break — and have flan-tastic adventures with her new berry besties!

title: The Magic School Bus Rides Again
overview: Ms. Frizzle's sister takes her class on a slew of wild science adventures in this update of the beloved animated show.

title: The Magic School Bus Rides Again: In the Zone
overview: Ms. Frizzle’s cousin, a pop star, performs worldwide on New Year’s Eve and the class has been invited backstage. When the Bus undergoes a software update during the tour, it starts to glitch and malfunction.

title: The Magic School Bus Rides Again: Kids in Space
overview: The Magic School Bus kids blast into orbit - and onto the International Space Station - only to find themselves on the run from a giant tardigrade.

title: The Magic School Bus Rides Again: The Frizz Connection
overview: Lightning splits the Magic School Bus into three pieces, scattering the class across the globe with different versions of Ms. Frizzle aboard each bus!

title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
overview: When something's wrong in the Rainbow Kingdom, bighearted guardian True and her best friend, Bartleby, are there to grant wishes and save the day.

title: True Tunes
overview: True and her friends are dropping sweet, silly beats with freshly modern music videos set to the sounds of classic nursery rhyme songs.

title: True: Friendship Day
overview: When a giant Grippity-Grab snags Grizelda's friendship bracelet and turns her into a mermaid, True heads under the sea with magic wishes to save the day.

title: True: Grabbleapple Harvest
overview: It's Grabbleapple harvest season in the Rainbow Kingdom ... but Glummy Glooma doesn't want autumn to come. Can True and her friends save the festival?

title: True: Happy Hearts Day
overview: True and Bartleby try to cheer up the Rainbow Kingdom's loneliest citizen, but his gloomy mood is contagious! Can a trio of wishes turn things around?

title: True: Magical Friends
overview: The power of friendship can solve any problem -- and the Rainbow Kingdom's got plenty to go around. Cue Bartleby and True for the rescue!

title: True: Terrific Tales
overview: Through the magic of the Story Spinner, True and her friends create their own versions of Pinocchio, Little Red Riding Hood and other classic tales.

title: True: Tricky Treat Day
overview: It's up to True and her friends to save the day when a hungry Yeti sneaks a forbidden treat and fills the kingdom with Howling Greenies.

title: True: Winter Wishes
overview: An ice crystal from a frosty realm is freezing everything in the Rainbow Kingdom, its citizens too! Can True save Winter Wishfest -- and her friends?

title: True: Wonderful Wishes
overview: Do-gooding True and Bartleby will go anywhere to make wishes come true -- from the bottom of the Living Sea to the tip of Mount Tippy Tippy Top!

title: True: Wuzzle Wegg Day
overview: Spring has sprung in Rainbow City, and Wuzzle Wegg Day is right around the corner! But Bartleby's convinced that a Wegg-stealing monster is on the loose.

title: Unicorn Academy: Secrets Revealed
overview: A new mystery unfolds at Unicorn Academy as long-buried secrets begin to surface, threatening the very balance of Unicorn Island. As Sophia and her friends return for another year, they are drawn into a dangerous quest filled with hidden powers, unexpected betrayals, and dark forces growing stronger in the shadows. With every step, the stakes rise, pushing the riders to their limits. Packed with magic, suspense, and emotional twists, this chapter promises a thrilling adventure where not everything is as it seems, and every secret could change their destiny forever.
